docs.title: Cobblemon PokeTowns
docs.text:
Discontinued

PokeTowns was never released and will not be. Its development has stopped, and this wiki no longer documents it.

For Pokémon Centers, Poké Marts, gyms and Kanto cities in your world, use Cobblemon Cities & Structures instead. It is the towns mod the pack uses now:

  • Routes connects its cities to the road network.
  • PokeGyms is being rebuilt on top of its gyms.
